readings_unlabelled.R1: Within one continuous arrangement, limbic drift stands beside the plane of the third-eye, while turbular erosion extends toward cosmic swamp-labyrinths. Beyond them are dreams and (meta)static pod-deliria and techno-immortalism, followed by shallow seas beside ‘fold-type’ time-anomalies. Further across the same scene appear trance-states and the dead eye of the cyclone, then swirling nebulae and the dense void of the cosmic hypermatrix. The elements remain in this exact order, joined only by direct spatial relations and continuation. Earlier elements remain nearer one another, later elements extend across the same scene, and nothing else is introduced beyond what was dealt.
readings_unlabelled.R2: Within one continuous arrangement, crypt-navigation stands beside swirling nebulae, while the metallic ocean of the earth’s iron core extends toward limbic drift. Beyond them are (meta)static pod-deliria and techno-immortalism and cosmic swamp-labyrinths, followed by shallow seas beside dreams. Further across the same scene appear armored fish creatures and enduring ideas, historical time and remembrance, then (meta)static pod-deliria and techno-immortalism and shallow seas. The elements remain in this exact order, joined only by direct spatial relations and continuation. Earlier elements remain nearer one another, later elements extend across the same scene, and nothing else is introduced beyond what was dealt.

target_scene: a basalt sea cliff, a cluster of mushrooms, under hard noon light, snow blowing sideways.
